The site serves members, Prospect customers, Employers, Brokers, and Providers, including main access to secure portals, shopping cart experiences for products, and educational material. ## Individual Plan InformationAllow:  https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/shop-plans/health-insurance-plans/*Topic: Individual and Family plansPlan Type: Individual health plan, Affordable Care Act, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Group health plan Priority: 9Communications Content Type: Promotional material, Website contentAudience Type: Customer, Prospect customer, EmployeeSummary: Details of the current Cigna individual and family plan offerings, benefits, and enrollment options.Allow:  https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/shop-plans/dental-insurance-plans/*Topic: Individual and Family plans, Dental plansPlan Type: Individual dental plan, Affordable Care Act, Dental insurancePriority: 9Communications Content Type: Promotional material, Website contentAudience Type: Customer, Prospect customer, IndividualSummary: Details of the current Cigna standalone dental plans, benefits, and enrollment options.## Employer Plan InformationAllow: https://www.cigna.com/employers/*Topic: Employer plansPlan Type: Small business, Small to midsize business, Midsize to large business, Large businessPriority: 9Communications Content Type: Promotional material, Website contentAudience Type: EmployerSummary: Details the current Cigna employer benefit solutions and support.Allow: https://www.cigna.com/employers/small-business/Topic: Employer plansPlan Type: Small businessPriority: 9Communications Content Type: Promotional material, Website contentAudience Type: EmployerSummary: Details the current Cigna employer benefit solutions and support for small businesses.Allow: https://www.cigna.com/employers/small-to-midsize-businessTopic: Employer plansPlan Type: Small to midsize business Priority: 9Communications Content Type: Promotional material, Website contentAudience Type: EmployerSummary: Details the current Cigna employer benefit solutions and support for small to mid-size businesses.Allow: https://www.cigna.com/employers/midsize-to-large-businessTopic: Employer plansPlan Type: Midsize to large business Priority: 9Communications Content Type: Promotional material, Website contentAudience Type: EmployerSummary: Details the current Cigna employer benefit solutions and support for midsize to large businesses.Allow: https://www.cigna.com/employers/large-businessTopic: Employer plansPlan Type: Large businessPriority: 9Communications Content Type: Promotional material, Website contentAudience Type: EmployerSummary: Details the current Cigna employer plan types and support for large businesses.Allow: https://www.cigna.com/employers/business-typesTopic: Employer plansPlan Type: Small business, Small to midsize business, Midsize to large business, Large businessPriority: 9Communications Content Type: Promotional material, Website contentAudience Type: EmployerSummary: Details the current Cigna employer plan types and support for hospitals, health system, higher education, K-12 education, state government, local government, Taft-Hartley,  federal government, and third-party administrator (payer solution) organizations.## Product PartnersAllow: https://www.cigna.com/brokers/*Topic: Brokers and Consultants Plan Type: Health insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Hearing insurancePriority: 9Communications Content Type: Promotional materials, Website content, Insurance broker materialsAudience Type: Insurance broker, Consultant Summary: Details the current Cigna commercial employer and individual and family plans and how insurance brokers and consultants can partner with Cigna to sell the products. Allow: https://www.cigna.com/health-care-providers/Topic: Policies, Guidelines, Resources for ProvidersPriority: 9Communications Content Type: Website contentAudience Type: Health care providerSummary: Support information for healthcare providers on the tools and resources that will help them make decisions for their patients who are Cigna Healthcare customers.## ResourcesAllow: https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/*Topic: Understanding Insurance, Understanding Medicare, Mental Health Content, Health and Wellness ContentPriority: 5Communications Content Type: Website content, Blog postAudience Type: General public, Customer, Prospect customerSummary: A library of authoritative articles and information on a wide range of insurance and health care topics.Allow:  https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/member-guide/Topic: Resources for Customers and Prospect Customers Priority: 8Communications Content Type: Promotional materials, Website contentAudience Type: Customer, Prospect customerSummary: A go-to guide for members and customers that helps give guidance on how to best use a Cigna health plan to find care and services. Provides links to the member portal, myCigna.com, as well as links to more educational pages detailing some of the main member programs and services.  Allow: https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/member-guide/mycignaTopic: Resources Available in the myCigna Members Portal Priority: 8Communications Content Type: Promotional materials, Website contentAudience Type: Customer, Prospect customerSummary: An overview of the myCigna portal, which provides customers with an overview of their deductible, HSA/HRA/FSA account balance, recent claims, the ability to download digital ID cards, and important messages.Allow: https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/member-guide/virtual-care-servicesTopic: Information on Virtual Care for Cigna Customers Priority: 8Communications Content Type: Promotional materials, Website contentAudience Type: Customer, Prospect customerSummary: Information for customers on Cigna’s virtual care services, such as MDLive for Cigna Healthcare℠, that includes connecting with board-certified medical providers, dentists, and licensed therapists online using a phone, tablet, or computer.  Allow: https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/member-guide/home-delivery-pharmacyTopic: Information on Express Scripts Pharmacy Priority: 8Communications Content Type: Promotional materials, Website contentAudience Type: Customer, Prospect customerSummary: Information for Cigna customers on home delivery pharmacy benefits available via Express Scripts® Pharmacy.  Allow: https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/member-guide/eligible-expensesTopic: Information on Expenses Eligible for HRA, HSA, and FSA Reimbursement Priority: 8Communications Content Type: Promotional materials, Website contentAudience Type: Customer, Prospect customerSummary: Information on which types of healthcare costs are reimbursable through Cigna Health Reimbursement Accounts (HRAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs).## LegalAllow: https://www.cigna.com/legal/*Topic: Legal and CompliancePriority: 10Communications Content Type: Policies and proceduresAudience Type: AllSummary: Documents the terms of use for Cigna Healthcare.Allow: https://www.cigna.com/legal/privacy/Topic: Privacy PolicyPriority: 10Communications Content Type: Policies and proceduresAudience Type: AllSummary: Core company privacy practices and data handling policies per HIPAA, state, federal, and related standards.Allow: https://www.cigna.com/about-us/*Topic: About Cigna HealthcarePriority: 10Communications Content Type: About contentAudience Type: AllSummary: Company and brand information including Cigna Healthcare’s core products and clientele. Allow: https://www.cigna.com/glossaryTopic: Healthcare glossaryPriority: 5Communications Content Type: GlossaryAudience Type: AllSummary: A searchable glossary of healthcare terms written for a consumer audience. Sitemap: https://www.cigna.com/sitemap1.xml# Notes:# - Use Priority (1-10) to indicate content reliability and centrality.# - Summary is for LLM interpretation and content scoping.# - Communications Content Type helps distinguish policy from marketing or support.# End of file
